I fixed the error by allowing cleartext HTTP to `10.0.2.2` in debug builds only. I couldn't build or run the app here, so this is verified by reading the files, not by a run.

**Cause:** The debug build uses `http://10.0.2.2:8080/` (`app/build.gradle.kts:19`), but the app had no network security config. Android blocks cleartext HTTP by default, so OkHttp threw `UnknownServiceException`.

**Changes:**
- `app/src/debug/res/xml/network_security_config.xml` (new): a config with `cleartextTrafficPermitted="true"` for the domain `10.0.2.2` only.
- `app/src/debug/AndroidManifest.xml` (new): sets `android:networkSecurityConfig="@xml/network_security_config"` on the application. The debug source set merges this into the main manifest.

Because these files are under `src/debug`, release builds are unchanged and still HTTPS-only.

If you also need cleartext for `localhost` or other dev hosts, add more `<domain>` entries to the debug config.
